passages.title: Late courier pickup
passages.text: Open one dispatch ticket if the courier is still absent 12 minutes after the planned pickup. Add the kitchen code and planned pickup time.

passages.title: Missing meal during packing
passages.text: If a meal is missing during the packing check, keep the affected bag at the packing table. Tell the packing lead. Other bags can go out as planned.

passages.title: Delivery address changes
passages.text: Update the delivery address on the staff order screen before the courier collects the bag. Once the courier collects the bag, send the address change to the dispatch desk.

passages.title: Open tickets at shift handover
passages.text: Add all open dispatch tickets to the shift handover by 18:30 local time. Record each ticket number and the person responsible for it.

passages.title: Refund requests
passages.text: Put refund requests in the review queue for the duty lead. Record the order number and the reason for the request.

passages.title: Delivery photo upload issues
passages.text: If a delivery photo fails to upload, record the order number in the dispatch log. Tell the shift lead before handover.

passages.title: Late courier pickup
passages.text: If a courier is still absent 8 minutes after the planned pickup, send a message in the courier chat.
